none: PAS NLM-5878B3: Roman Coin: Nummus of Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin fragment. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Emperor right issue of 364-375, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust diademed right. Obverse inscription: (--)ENTIN VS[---]. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right holding labarum and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Diameter: 19.4mm, Weight: 1.50gms, die axis: 12
